title: てるてる坊主 (Teru Teru Bōzu)
description: A beloved children's song about making a paper doll to wish for sunny weather. Hung by a window the night before an important day, the teru teru bōzu (shine-shine monk) is promised sweet sake if it brings clear skies — and a grim fate if it does not. One of the most recognisable Japanese children's songs, published in 1921.
license: Public Domain (lyrics: 浅原鏡村 1921, music: 中山晋平 1921 — both authors deceased 50+ years)
